{{Otheruses|Defense Station}}
'''Orbital defense stations''' were a kind of [[Space station/Legends|space station]] used to protect [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. [[Chandrila Orbital Station|One]] such station orbited the planet [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] about 4,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> Orbital defense stations were armed with [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launchers]] with a large ammunition capacity.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
